from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib

matplotlib.use("Agg")

import numpy as np

D = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
INS, QC = D / "insitu", D / "qc"
CACHE = Path("/mnt/c/Users/cabot/OneDrive/Documents/Research/Cambridge/X3I/analysis_repro/analysis_06_solar_wind/cache")
CACHES = {
    "stereo_a": ("stereo_a.csv", ["v", "n"]),
    "solar_orbiter": ("solar_orbiter.csv", ["v", "n"]),
    "ace": ("ace.csv", ["n", "v"]),
    "wind": ("wind.csv", ["pls", "n", "v"]),
}


def read(path, **kw):
    d = pd.read_csv(path, **kw)
    d["time"] = pd.to_datetime(d.pop("utc") if "utc" in d else d.pop("time"), utc=True, format="ISO8601")
    return d


def cache(name):
    file, cols = CACHES[name]
    d = pd.read_csv(CACHE / file, header=None, names=["time", *cols])
    d["time"] = pd.to_datetime(d.time, utc=True, format="ISO8601")
    return d.set_index("time")


def rebin(df, offset):
    t = df.time - pd.Timedelta(offset)
    g = df.groupby(t.dt.floor("1h"))[["n", "v"]]
    m = g.mean().where(g.count() >= 30)
    m.index = m.index + pd.Timedelta(offset)
    return m


def stats(a, b):
    j = a[["n", "v"]].join(b[["n", "v"]], lsuffix="_mine", rsuffix="_cache", how="inner").dropna()
    if not len(j):
        return {"n_overlap": 0}
    out = {"n_overlap": int(len(j))}
    for c in ("n", "v"):
        r = j[f"{c}_mine"] / j[f"{c}_cache"]
        out[f"{c}_median_ratio"] = float(r.median())
        out[f"{c}_p05_p95_ratio"] = [float(r.quantile(0.05)), float(r.quantile(0.95))]
        out[f"{c}_frac_within_10pct"] = float((np.abs(r - 1) < 0.1).mean())
        x, y = (np.log(j[f"{c}_mine"]), np.log(j[f"{c}_cache"])) if c == "n" else (j[f"{c}_mine"], j[f"{c}_cache"])
        out[f"{c}_pearson" + ("_log" if c == "n" else "")] = float(np.corrcoef(x, y)[0, 1])
        out[f"{c}_max_abs_diff"] = float(np.abs(j[f"{c}_mine"] - j[f"{c}_cache"]).max())
    return out
